qa: [Security] effects take precedence for activation. Upon a security check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation. For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.

text_sections.text: ＜Barrier＞ ＜Partition ([Angewomon] & [LadyDevimon])＞ [When Digivolving] You may play 1 level 5 or lower yellow or purple card from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, if this Digimon's stack has 2 or more same-level cards, trash the top cards of both players' security stacks so that they have 3 cards left. [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When security stacks are removed from, you may place 1 Digimon as the bottom security card.
